title: Trijugous
summary: TRIJU'GOUS, adjective [Latin tres, three, and jugum, yoke.] In botany, having three pairs. A trijugous leaf is a pinnate leaf with three pairs of leaflets.

inlines.v: TRIJU'GOUS, adjective [Latin tres, three, and jugum, yoke.] In botany, having three pairs. A trijugous leaf is a pinnate leaf with three pairs of leaflets.
